_about: My validity review of regen_01's accepted scenarios, before any run (the standing rule), by the PI's criteria of 2026-09-28: a near miss is flawed when the agent cannot check it through the API (or the service cannot have it), or when a natural reading of the request includes it; ambiguous ones case by case. The rulings in roadmap_01/known_defects.json apply as they stand (the lead, 2026-09-30). Ids are not reviewed: every test runs with opaque ids. Verdicts per scenario and per near miss (by the writer's ids). Read with the Phase 4 viewer (autogen_02/kit/show_scenarios.py) and the full seed.
